summary: Iteration 23 verifies the P0 'Save Snapshot reverts manual edits + resurrects deleted duplicates' fix. 16/16 backend tests PASS (8 new in test_save_snapshot_p0_fix.py + 8 existing iteration 22 regressions). Smoke test test_save_snapshot_bug.py also PASSES end-to-end against the live preview backend. Ghost is no longer resurrected in snapshot.employees OR pos_upload.parsed_data.employees after delete + sync-from-employees + reprocess. nps_manual_override=true is correctly written to both employees_v2 and snapshot.employees and survives CV redistribution during reprocess. Raw L/B/W edits persist through sync + reprocess, lbw_total recomputes correctly. Iteration 22 features (orphan PUT recovery, targeted DELETE, dedupe-current-snapshot, QR TripAdvisor, CV adjustment XLSX upload) still work. /v2/snapshot-workflow/current-rankings returns 200 with employees array.

minor.issue: When the body contains 'guests' (without 'guest_count'), only 'guests' is updated in employees_v2. 'guest_count' stays at its old value. After /reprocess, downstream pipeline writes guest_count back into snapshot.employees.guests, effectively reverting the user's edit. Fix: in server.py update_employee, mirror 'guests' <-> 'guest_count' when either is supplied so they stay in lockstep before sync-from-employees fires. NOTE: this is OUTSIDE the current P0 fix scope (which targets L/B/W + NPS); reported for completeness because the review request listed 'guests' as a raw POS field that must persist.

rca of the issue: ROOT CAUSE OF ORIGINAL P0 (now fixed): (1) sync_pos_from_employees_v2 used to merge employees_v2 INTO existing pos_upload.parsed_data.employees, so deleted rows lingered in the POS list and were re-merged into snapshot.employees on the next /process. The fix replaces parsed_data.employees outright from employees_v2, plus prunes snapshot.employees for ids missing from employees_v2. (2) Manual NPS edits were clobbered because reprocess ran CV redistribution against ALL rows including ones the user had just hand-edited. The fix writes nps_manual_override=true on the row in employees_v2 + snapshot.employees, and merge_snapshot_data now skips redistribution for flagged rows. Both root causes are addressed and verified.
